aegisperms.manual.legend: Each mod has its table of commands, then one section per command: its description and its tree, one node per line, with its name (an argument between `<>`), the key it is judged on, and what matters: executable; the op level vanilla requires, when it changes; a mod predicate, which the mod cannot read; a sensitive key; a node more demanding than its ancestor; a redirect; a shared node, described under its own key. A rule is set on a key and covers what descends from it; a prefixed form and an alias are judged on the key of their target.
